authorization.writes: all corresponding reads AND projects.manage; open project; CSRF; no implicit role or assignment authority
authorization.source_review: No review/manage permission needed for citation; source lifecycle never changes

text: Rationale/removal reason use the existing project30 blank-set boundary normalization before 1..500 Unicode-code-point validation. New input text/search rejects NUL and unpaired Unicode surrogates with422 before PostgreSQL. Snapshot labels are copied unchanged from source and may need an unnamed fallback in UI.

page.items: typed array <=limit; scope and versions retained even for empty/off-end pages

link_common.removal_reason: empty while active; normalized nonempty max500 after removal
link_common.current_target_state: kind-specific enum; diagnostic observation, not verification

document_candidate.tenant_id: source uuid, must match page context
document_candidate.unit_id: source uuid, must match page context
document_candidate.title: string max200

evidence_candidate.tenant_id: source uuid, must match page context
evidence_candidate.unit_id: source uuid, must match page context
evidence_candidate.name: evidence name string max160

routes.response: Page<DocumentLink>; active first, created_at/id descending; includes removed history
Page<DocumentCandidate>; active document plus active clean revision only; eligibility before pagination; code/id stable ordering
Page<EvidenceCandidate>; accepted evidence plus active implementation only; eligibility before pagination; implementation code/evidence sequence/id ordering
201 {project:ProjectDetail,link:DocumentLink}; project+step versions each+1, link.row_version1 and active
200 {project:ProjectDetail,link:DocumentLink}; project+step+link versions each+1, statusremoved, immutable snapshots/rationale retained

errors: 401 session;403 missing capability;404 hidden/missing project/step/link;409 stale versions/duplicate/source/scope/archive conflicts;422 invalid body/query. No upstream narrative in client diagnostics.
rules: No new project status or step completion; feature_pending and all follow-up content/assignment/date stay unchanged after link commands.
Both selected container and target versions must match at add validation. Later source lifecycle changes preserve snapshots; current-state diagnostics may become historical or unavailable.
Accepted evidence citation does not re-evaluate its attached document or accept this project step.
Link SQL trigger advances project+step through0050 protocol, no caller-controlled snapshot data. API audit and data transaction atomic.
Active duplicates prohibited per step/target revision or evidence; removed history permits a new citation row. No DELETE/edit/restore link commands.
Source read revocation hides corresponding link rows and candidates; missing source capability is restricted, not zero evidence.
All response snapshots/IDs are same company/unit; no owner bypass, auto grants or cross-tenant source queries.
Client validates current scope and expected versions, preserves drafts for409/uncertain responses, requires explicit reconciliation and never blindly retries a write. Exact201/200 receipts only.
